recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy adopts a later decision changing MedicationStatement.derivedFrom targets, dosage semantics, or core elements for request/dispense details.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue from DSTU1 asking why MedicationStatement did not reference MedicationDispense or Prescription to link a statement to an order and possibly avoid inline dosing details. The resolution was to add MedicationStatement commentary that dosage information is independent of dispense or prescription information and is not conducted from those resources in FHIR, addressed as part of FHIR-7167.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-6223 was found. FHIR-6223 itself says it was addressed as part of FHIR-7167, and historical commit 7d50996061 (#7167, svn 6686), followed by e7200c208f, applied MedicationStatement purpose and prescribe/dispense/administer boundary wording that remains represented in current source.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription was later renamed to MedicationRequest. Current active MedicationStatement narrative distinguishes MedicationStatement from MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationAdministration, says it is independent of specific events, and tells implementers to use MedicationStatement.derivedFrom to link to the request, dispense, or administration used to derive the statement. Later FHIR-13695 and its Zulip discussion support using derivedFrom for request/dispense details rather than adding core MedicationStatement fields. FHIR-41500, already on the combined branch, clarifies informationSource separately from derivedFrom.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current active introduction and StructureDefinition already provide the FHIR-6223 guidance without adding redundant prose.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-6223 was explicitly recorded as addressed as part of FHIR-7167, whose applied wording clarified MedicationStatement purpose and related-resource boundaries.

Later no-change decision says prescription and dispense details can be reached through MedicationStatement.derivedFrom references to MedicationRequest and MedicationDispense rather than new core fields.
Later applied change clarified informationSource as who/what provided information while preserving derivedFrom for source resources; already represented on the combined branch.
Later R5 decision restored the MedicationStatement name and stated the resource scope had not changed, preserving the relevant MedicationStatement boundary.

evidence_items.summary: 2017 discussion says MedicationStatement may be derived from prescription/order or dispense resources, using MedicationStatement.derivedFrom to point to full MedicationRequest or MedicationDispense resources, while core fields should not carry non-universal request/dispense dates.
evidence_items.learned: Community rationale aligns with the current derivedFrom pattern and does not conflict with FHIR-6223's no-conduction resolution.
